issues: rate_path.rationale mentions year 2014, after the minutes release date 2012-07-11.

evidence.quote: In their discussion of monetary policy for the period ahead, members agreed that it would be appropriate to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent in order to support a stronger economic recovery

In light of their assessment of the economic situation, almost all members again agreed to indicate that the Committee expects to maintain a highly accommodative stance for monetary policy and currently anticipates that economic conditions--including low rates of resource utilization

rate_path.rationale: The minutes state the Committee agreed to keep the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent and expect a highly accommodative stance through late 2014. The forward guidance was issued at the meeting's release date, so the reference to 2014 is part of the official statement and not a future projection.
